Hi Liam — thanks for the clear list. Summary below with owners and an initial delivery runway. If any of these targets are too aggressive for your board, tell me and we'll pivot.

1) SOC 2 evidence (owner: marcus_lin) — we can provide control narratives and SOC 2 Type II excerpts for 2028; target delivery: 2028-11-10. Attachment: SOC2-excerpt.pdf (control summary).

2) SIG/CAIQ mapping (owner: marcus_lin) — we'll export the CAIQ mapping and include clarifying notes on controls that are in progress. Target: 2028-11-12. We'll surface a matrix showing "Implemented / In progress / Planned" status per question.

3) DPA negotiation (owner: neha_kapoor) — we reviewed the redline. High-level: most baseline clauses are acceptable, but we have standard carveouts on backup encryption and lawful request handling. I'll circulate a redline with counterpoints by 2028-11-07.

4) Data retention (owner: hannah_schmitt + neha_kapoor) — default retention windows: logs 3 years, backups 90 days, prompt/content retention configurable with a default 30 days. If NovaBank requires 7-year retention for logs, we need to scope storage/residency options and an uplift for archive storage. We can provide a cost estimate within 48 hours after you confirm scope.

Next steps: Marcus — can you confirm the SOC2 excerpt and CAIQ export availability? Neha — will send the DPA counter by EOD 11/07. Liam — we'll add these dates to a shared MAP doc and lock the pilot close target of 2028-11-24 if evidence timelines are met.

Hi Liam — looping in legal for the thread. Quick notes on the DPA and retention negotiation: 

- DPA: we reviewed your redline. We can accept most of your edits but will keep our standard limitation of liability language and request a mutual notice period for lawful requests. I'll attach a counter-redline (DPA-redline-hs-v2.docx) and track changes. Expect it by 2028-11-07 EOD.

- Sub-processors: we already publish a sub-processor list and notify customers of material changes 30 days in advance. We can't agree to unlimited prior approval for every sub-processor; propose "notification + right to object within 14 days" as a compromise.

- Retention: regarding the 7-year log request — we can offer a scoped archival solution with EU-region residency guaranteed (using partner infra in eu-west-1). There will be a monthly cost delta and an initial configuration fee. We'll produce an estimate by 2028-11-05.
